scope: Only darwin/arm64 was executed. Other OS/arch are NOT_TESTED and must not inherit this PASS.

buildPolicy.reason: better-sqlite3 13.0.3 declares no install/postinstall script and ships prebuilt N-API binaries; pnpm 11 otherwise blocks the install with ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS. Declining the build keeps the install non-interactive and provably compile-free.
buildPolicy.equivalentAlternative: pnpm install --config.strict-dep-builds=false (less explicit; not used in this candidate)

tested: clean dependency install from the committed lockfile with pnpm 11.7.0 on Node 24.22.2 (exit 0, no compiler)
explicit load of the shipped prebuild via nativeBinding
same-transaction commit of state + effect + receipt
injected rollback breakpoint: all three records rolled back
reader connection sees committed rows only
integrity_check and foreign_key_check on the probe database
online backup from a live WAL database to a new directory, with one concurrent writer commit
restore: integrity_check=ok, foreign_key_check=0, schema digest identical, seeded rows present
SIGKILL after commit: committed row survives
SIGKILL before COMMIT: open transaction is rolled back
node:test suites under Node 24.21.0 and 24.22.2 (4/4 each)
notTested: large databases, long-running WAL growth, backup throughput under load
power loss, filesystem failure, NFS or sync-folder state directories
multi-process writers, writer lease, product Store schema and migrations
afterCommit ordering, queue/effect implementation, business-level recovery (OPS-02, REL-*)
product artifact files, Runner journals, native agent processes
macOS code signing, notarization and universal binaries
node:sqlite as an alternative binding (no ADR; deliberately not switched)

blockers.summary: pnpm 11 blocks install of better-sqlite3 as an unapproved builder although the package has no build scripts.
blockers.mitigation: Explicit allowBuilds: better-sqlite3: false in the local pnpm-workspace.yaml; re-run this probe whenever the binding version changes.
